newsitem.title: CHINA: Int'l Tak Cheung sells Nam Pei Hong stake.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Tak Cheung sells Nam Pei Hong stake.

text.p: International Tak Cheung Holdings Ltd (ITC) and associate Paul Y-ITC Construction Holdings Ltd have agreed to sell their aggregate 33 percent stake in Nam Pei Hong (Holdings) Ltd to a third party, Nam Pei Hong said in a statement on Thursday.

ITC and Paul Y have agreed to sell their respective 101.02 million and 9.57 million Nam Pei Hong shares at HK$1.50 each to an independent third party, Victory Hunter Holdings Ltd, a company owned by Yau Wai Ming, Nam Pei Hong said.

Yau, a member of the Heilongjiang Provincial Political Consultative Committee, has been involved in import and export of electronic and electrical goods, tobacco and chemical fertiliser. He also has interests in China property development.

Nam Pei Hong said Yau would hold the company stake as a long term investment and would not alter the existing business and management of the company and there was no immediate plan for any asset injection.
Victory Hunter, which did not hold any Nam Pei Hong shares prior to the deal, will be the company's largest shareholder.
ITC said in a separate statement it would use the proceeds from the sale to reduce banks debt and for working capital.
Trading in Nam Pei Hong shares which suspended since July 24, will remain suspended pending further announcement.
Nam Pei Hong is a Chinese medicine and health food retailer and maker. It also has property investment.
